name: Yellow Pages Directory (formerly YellowPagesGoesGreen.org)

sources.title: Wikipedia — YellowPagesGoesGreen.org rebranded to YellowPagesDirectory.com, owned by Yellow Pages Directory Inc., East Northport NY
Premium Package page — describes free business listings and a paid premium upgrade (found via search; page indexed with 'Add Business' nav)
Third-party coverage — paid plans starting around $49.95/yr; free consumer directory positioning

conditions: Free business listing exists but is gated to real US local businesses with verifiable NAP (name, address, phone) data; site pushes an annual premium package for extra categories and verified perks
requirements: US business with a real street address and phone number — this is a Yellow Pages/White Pages citation directory, not a SaaS launch board
Batch domain yellowpagesgoesgreen.org is the former brand; the live site is yellowpagesdirectory.com
Online-only SaaS products without a local business address do not fit the directory model
preparation: Canonical NAP: business name, physical address, local phone number — must match other citations
Business category selection and a short plain-text description
Decide whether the listing is claimed as an existing record or added new
workflow: Go to yellowpagesdirectory.com and use the 'Add Business' nav entry
Search for an existing listing first; claim it if present, otherwise create a new free listing
Submit NAP + category + description; expect verification before the listing is confirmed
Decline the premium package upsell if only a citation is wanted
watchFor: Site 403-blocks automated fetches — verify form fields manually in a browser
Aggressive premium-package upsell (~$49.95+/yr per third-party reporting); the free tier exists but is positioned as a lead-in
Pure-SaaS products without a US local presence will not produce a meaningful citation
countsAsLive: The business listing resolves on a public yellowpagesdirectory.com listing page via the site's search or browse-by-listing-id
unknowns: Exact free-tier field set and verification method (phone/postcard) — official pages bot-blocked during research
Current turnaround time for free listings
Whether outbound website links on free listings are followed
